title: Cache stampede after a Redis eviction/restart
description: A Redis restart during scheduled maintenance emptied the catalog cache: hit rate dropped 96% to 4% for ~90s, DB read QPS jumped ~800 to ~11,400, Postgres pool exhausted for ~40s, and p95 latency rose 80ms to 4.8s. The restart-to-load-spike timing correlation is directly observed; calling this specific mechanism (vs. another cause) fully responsible remains a well-supported but inferred conclusion.
